definitions.explanation: The polite/honorific form of {挨拶|あいさつ}, used in formal contexts such as business, ceremonies, and official communication. Covers spoken greetings, formal speeches, and written salutations.

examples.japanese: ご{挨拶|あいさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
examples.english: I offer my greetings. (formal opening phrase)

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a greeting from the company president.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伺|うかが}いたい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧。
examples.english: I would like to visit to give my year-end greetings.

examples.japanese: ⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冒頭|ぼうとう}→冒頭：11725_boutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write a greeting at the beginning of an email.

notes:
The honorific form of ⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧, formed by adding the prefix ご. Used in formal, business, and ceremonial contexts. In Japanese business culture, greetings are an important social ritual — visiting clients for seasonal greetings or giving a formal speech at events are standard expectations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{挨拶|あいさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げる→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧: to offer one's greetings (very formal)
- ご{挨拶|あいさつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{伺|うかが}う: to visit to pay one's respects
- ご{挨拶|あいさつ}{回|まわ}り: going around to give greetings (e.g., to neighbors, business contacts)
- ⟦{年末年始|ねんまつねんし}→年末年始：12457_nenmatsunenshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}: year-end/new year greetings
- ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}: the president's address/greeting

COMMON SITUATIONS:
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}: greeting neighbors when moving in
- ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}: wedding speech
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ご{挨拶|あいさつ}: farewell greeting upon leaving a job

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: greeting — the plain form, used in everyday/casual contexts
- ⟦{祝辞|しゅくじ}→祝辞：14759_shukuji⟧: congratulatory speech — a more specific formal term for celebratory addresses
